scope: Egypt/tablet/King-profile domain. These records do not enter the Human 3204 bank without a separate cross-domain Human-functional case.

candidates.name: Commission Origin Type
candidates.definition: Candidate role that initiated or authorized artifact creation: ruler, queen/family, priesthood, court, institution, workshop/decorator, other or unknown.

candidates.name: Physical Maker / Workshop Role
candidates.definition: Candidate identity/class of physical maker distinct from commissioner and depicted actor.

candidates.name: Artifact Functional Context
candidates.definition: Dedication, ritual/liturgy, funerary, family memorial, succession, campaign/victory, treaty/diplomatic, restoration, decorative or other context.

candidates.name: Regency / Co-Regency Signal
candidates.definition: Evidence that represented ruler status and operative authority were shared or mediated by regents/co-rulers.

candidates.name: Name Erasure / Replacement Signal
candidates.definition: Evidence of deliberate removal, overwrite, replacement or suppression of a royal identity marker.

candidates.name: Ritual Name-Recitation Function
candidates.definition: Contextual hypothesis that an inscribed name participates in repeated ritual speech or maintenance practice.

candidates.name: Series Membership / Repetition Unit
candidates.definition: Whether an artifact is standalone or one unit in a repeated yearly, decadal, temple, campaign or other series.

candidates.name: Lineage Memorial Function
candidates.definition: Whether artifact primarily encodes family, heir, dynastic continuity or succession memory.

candidates.name: Posthumous Identity Anchor Function
candidates.definition: Whether artifact functions as a durable representation of identity after bodily death or absence.

candidates.name: Public Face / Hidden Power Signature
candidates.definition: Whether represented royal identity differs from evidence about the operative controller or power-holder.

candidates.name: Workshop-Style Continuity
candidates.definition: Degree of stylistic, material or manufacturing continuity with same-era pieces from a workshop or production network.

candidates.name: Symbolic Completion State
candidates.definition: Source-local interpretation dimension for partial/full glyph forms as incomplete/complete state; never assumed universal.

candidates.name: Restoration / Re-Carving Status
candidates.definition: Evidence that artifact was repaired, reinscribed, re-carved or created as part of restoration after disruption.

candidates.name: Campaign-Theatre Encoding
candidates.definition: Whether spatial/column structure maps separate campaigns, theatres, years, stages or tributary domains.

candidates.name: Treaty / Negotiated-Balance Function
candidates.definition: Whether artifact encodes diplomatic settlement, reciprocal status or negotiated balance rather than victory/submission.

candidates.name: Funerary / Afterlife Journey Encoding
candidates.definition: Whether sequence or spatial structure maps a funerary, solar or afterlife journey under source-supported context.

scope_guard: A domain-local symbol or artifact feature is not a Human parameter merely because it appears in a King profile.
